hash: sha256 of the UTF-8 bytes of canonical_json
notes: Object keys sort by UTF-16 code unit (JS semantics), not code point.
Python: json.dumps(ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',',':'), sort_keys=...) with a UTF-16-aware key sort.
TypeScript: build the sorted object with Object.create(null).
Floats are rejected at the input boundary; hashed fields are integers only.

vectors.name: empty_object
vectors.why: baseline

vectors.name: empty_array
vectors.why: baseline

vectors.name: key_sorting_basic
vectors.why: keys must be reordered, not preserved in insertion order

vectors.name: proto_key
vectors.why: TS: a normal object literal makes __proto__ hit Object.prototype's setter, no own property is created, and the key VANISHES from the canonical string while surviving in the file. Content could be parked in an anchored event uncommitted by the hash. Object.create(null) is mandatory.

vectors.name: constructor_key
vectors.why: same class of prototype-pollution hazard as __proto__

vectors.name: html_chars
vectors.why: Go's encoding/json escapes < > & by default as \u003c etc. SetEscapeHTML(false) is REQUIRED or Go diverges from TS.

vectors.name: non_ascii
vectors.why: Python's json.dumps defaults to ensure_ascii=True and escapes all non-ASCII. ensure_ascii=False is REQUIRED.

vectors.name: cjk
vectors.why: multi-byte UTF-8, no escaping in TS

vectors.name: emoji_surrogate_pair
vectors.why: Outside the BMP. JS strings are UTF-16 so this is a surrogate pair; affects both encoding and key ordering.

vectors.name: key_sorting_astral
vectors.why: THE ordering trap. JS sorts by UTF-16 code unit, Python by code point, Go by UTF-8 byte. An astral-plane key sorts DIFFERENTLY under JS than under a naive port, producing a different canonical string and a different hash.

vectors.name: control_characters
vectors.why: short escapes (\n \t) vs \u00XX form must match exactly
